title: [NBL27 Round 7] Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online @ Hungry Jack's App
body:
Deal: [NBL27 Round 7] Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (in-Store or via Drive-Thru) or with $1 Minimum Spend Online @ Hungry Jack's App

[new2onlineshopping] For those who prefer to manually enter it in the NBL app, or directly on the NBL website, here , the codeword for tonight's game (Cairns Taipans v Melbourne United) is FANS .
I will (or other users can) reply to this comment with further codewords as they are announced during this current NBL27 Round 7.
[new2onlineshopping] Many thanks to maccam01 for sending me this codeword via DM (and not posting a deal instead) while I was typing this post as I too had seen the codeword via Kayo.
[new2onlineshopping] Codeword for the Perth Wildcats v Illawarra Hawk game tonight is PEAK - credit to Salesniper in the comments below.
[AsukaST] Thanks OP, hopefully we will have another 14 rounds of free burgers until the end of this season of NBL lol.
[new2onlineshopping] At least we have free cheeseburgers all long-weekend (for those in Melbourne who get a public holiday on Tuesday for the Melbourne Cup and take a day off on Monday). Just remember that this direct link can only be used once per HJ account that hasn't had the free cheeseburger this round, until 11:59pm on Monday night, so you a get voucher that expires the day after when you click on the direct link.
Enjoy! :)
[jace88] Thanks team. I need a free cheeseburger!
